    Create stylish knitted creations with this Yarn Bee Braided Basics XXL. This yarn features a mix of recycled fibers braided together to form a small cord. Use this yarn for macrame or to accent an outfit for a unique pop of color and texture!

     

    *No discounts may be applied to “your price” or “reduced” items.

     

    Note: We are aware of the importance of dye lots and make every effort to pull the same dye lot on orders for multiple skeins of yarn; however, we are unable to guarantee all skeins will be the same dye lot.

    • Content: 54% Cotton & 46% Polyester
    • Color Code: Black
    • Yarn Weight: 5 - Bulky
    • Recommended Knitting Needles: 8-10mm (USA: Size 11-15/ UK: Size 0-000)
    • Knit Gauge: 10 Stitches x 18 Rows = 4" x 4"
    • Recommended Crochet Hook: 8-10mm Crotchet Hook (USA: Size 11-15/ UK: Size 0-000)
    • Crochet Gauge: 8 Single Crotchet x 8 Rows = 4" x 4"
    • Skein Weight: 8.82 Ounces
    • Skein Yardage: 71 Yards
    • Quantity: 1

     

    Care:

    • Wash At Or Below 30° Celsius
    • Do Not Bleach
    • Do Not Tumble Dry
    • Iron, Low Temp
    • Do Not Dry Clean
